subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, com autonomia, cartas pessoais e diários, com expressão de sentimentos e opiniões, dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, de acordo com as convenções do gênero carta e considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar as convenções estruturais do gênero carta pessoal
components.description_en: Identify the structural conventions of the personal letter genre
components.cc_component_description: Identify the correct placement of a comma in a letter greeting

components.description_pt: Identificar expressões de sentimentos e opiniões em cartas pessoais e diários
components.description_en: Identify expressions of feelings and opinions in personal letters and diary entries
components.cc_component_description: Express personal thoughts and feelings clearly in spoken communication

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender cartas pessoais e diários independentemente
components.description_en: Read and comprehend personal letters and diary entries independently
components.cc_component_description: Read and comprehend grade 6–8 literary nonfiction texts independently and proficiently

components.description_pt: Interpretar cartas pessoais e diários considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema
components.description_en: Interpret personal letters and diary entries considering the communicative situation and topic
components.cc_component_description: Identify characteristics of various text types and their communicative purposes

cc_matches.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literary nonfiction in the grades 6—8 text complexity band proficiently, with scaffolding as needed at the high end of the range.
Use commas in greetings and closings of letters.
Speak audibly and express thoughts, feelings, and ideas clearly.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar explicaciones para...
* presentar o definir temas
* describir cómo funciona u ocurre algo
* agregar precisión y detalles
* exponer las características de textos y sus propósitos
* relacionar diferencias en una variedad de textos
